description_for_human: Generate full HTML contracts by replacing placeholders with user-supplied data.
description_for_model: Plugin that creates contracts from a full HTML template. Pass 'template', 'party1', 'party2', 'date', 'scope_of_work', 'payment_terms', 'start_date', 'end_date', and 'termination_clause' to the /generate-template endpoint.
